title: Urinary Tract Infection (UTI): Symptoms, Causes and When It's an Emergency
seoTitle: UTI Symptoms and Causes: Bladder vs Kidney Infection
seoDescription: UTI symptoms include burning urine, frequent urges and cloudy urine. Learn the causes, kidney infection warning signs and when to see a doctor in India.
excerpt: How to tell a simple bladder infection from a kidney infection, how UTIs show up differently in children, older people and diabetics, and why India's rising antibiotic resistance makes self-medication risky.
